sources.municipalitySelection: Chuo City is selected by clipping mesh points to the official MLIT N03 Chuo polygon.
sources.notes: Primary P8-B evidence source. Used to extract Chuo spatial maximum inundation depth, maximum tsunami height, and arrival-time sample points from Tokyo official tsunami CSVs for Taisho Kanto earthquake and Nankai Trough case 1. Maximum tsunami height remains separate from the inundation-depth grid. Case 5 and case 8 are listed as checked/not present in the current generated Chuo layer, not as extracted scenarios. 都心南部直下地震 is not available / not a tsunami scenario in current extracted layers and is not claimed as extracted tsunami data.

sources.title: National Land Numerical Information N03 administrative boundary, Tokyo, 2024
sources.notes: Official administrative boundary used to clip Tokyo tsunami mesh points to Chuo City. It is not a tsunami source by itself.

sources.title: Tokyo Metropolitan Government damage-estimation report tsunami sections / 東京都「首都直下地震等による東京の被害想定」 source-family context
sources.notes: Official metropolitan report source-family context. Values guide P8-B provenance and scenario labels, but maximum tsunami height is not a substitute for an extracted inundation-depth surface. P8-B extraction is limited to 大正関東地震 and 南海トラフ巨大地震 case 1; no 都心南部直下地震-specific tsunami layer is extracted or claimed.

sources.title: Chuo City page on tsunami and liquefaction
sources.notes: Chuo City references the Tokyo Metropolitan Government damage estimation report for tsunami numerical simulation results. It is a provenance bridge, not a standalone Chuo tsunami hazard map dataset. The current extracted tsunami layers remain 大正関東地震 and 南海トラフ巨大地震 case 1 only.

sources.title: Supplementary public PDF reference for Tokyo Bay tsunami height by municipality
sources.notes: Supplementary reference for the older 2.46m Chuo maximum tsunami-height value. Treat as a height reference only until source lineage and scenario assumptions are reviewed.

sources.title: Chuo flood hazard map materials, non-tsunami proxy fallback only
sources.notes: Flood material is not the tsunami evidence source for P8-B. Keep only as a non-tsunami proxy fallback if Tokyo tsunami evidence cannot be extracted for a later prototype.

notes: P8-B prioritizes Tokyo Metropolitan Government tsunami damage estimation evidence for Chuo. 東京都「首都直下地震等による東京の被害想定」 is the broader source-family/report context; the actual extracted tsunami spatial layers are 大正関東地震 and 南海トラフ巨大地震 case 1. 都心南部直下地震 is not available / not a tsunami scenario in current extracted layers. Chuo's lack of a standalone tsunami hazard map is not treated as absence of tsunami evidence. Chuo flood hazard map material is not used as tsunami data.
